summary: Independent verification of P0 CRM-only login fallback + P1 Pulse Pro Documents category selection & upload progress drawer. 9/9 backend pytest cases pass; frontend flow verified end-to-end via Playwright (dropdown with 8 categories, Contracts count 1→2 after upload, General stayed at 0, upload-queue-drawer + upload-task-progress rendered).

issues: Toast text 'Added to Contracts' was not observable in DOM at ~4s post-upload (likely auto-dismisses quickly). Not a blocker — upload drawer shows Complete + tab count increments correctly.
